newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Gilts seen under pressure, 111-02 beckons.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Gilts seen under pressure, 111-02 beckons.

text.p: June gilts will likely come under pressure on Tuesday from a weakening French bond market after a surprise strong showing for the French left in Sunday's first round of elections, analysts said.
"We think that's going to weigh on gilts," said Elizabeth Miller, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Miller said a slide could expose gilts to the May 6 low of 111-02, the pivotal level before the market spiked higher.
"We should see an acceleration if we break that level," she said. By 0715 GMT, the June contract was down 10/32 on the day at 112-05.
